package.name: airmouse_sensors
package.description: Sensor bridge configuration for AirMouse: maps the Gazebo (gz) RGB-D camera and IMU topics of the simulated X500 onto the roadmap ROS topics (/camera/color/image_raw, /camera/depth/image_rect_raw, camera_info, /camera/depth/color/points, /camera/imu) and /clock.
